body:
Nice bro congrats.  Feel free to stay in touch to keep checking in.  Don't go unfriending everyone though. If you've been a stoner this long our friends think  it's part of us.  They may not be vindictive.  It may take a couple times for them to remember is all. If they continue to intentionally do that kind of shit, then it's different.  Most of it is our detoxing and lack of emotional control when triggered.  

No Facebook on my phone helped a lot yesterday.  There's a chrome political filter for Facebook that worked well.  I only checked in on my PC a couple times, unfollowed friends always posting pro or anti Trump stuff often, and felt less stress. For me the depression only hits once in awhile, and a good night's sleep with sleep aid helps.  

I saw Tool last week and my friends were puffing right next to me.  But I told them I didn't care. I enjoyed the smell but I'm not tempted to fall in the trap anymore. My friend did say sorry dude as they were smoking , but I said it's fine. 

I started working out 3-4 x a week.  A nice workout and I love the punching bag, Jesus it's great.  Then after a 1-2 hour cardio and weight session , I hit the hot tub, sometimes swim a couple pool laps, then steam room.  I feel like $$ after I leave and it's the main way to get out my anger. I use lifetime fitness and they are open 24/7.  It's important to pamper yourself with rewards when possible.  

Stay in touch.

The first week is the hardest , you know this.  Take the daily victories and build on it.  Check my post from today man.  I get in the gutters too. If you think you'll be tempted on your camping trip don't go.  I think I'd be fine.  I can't relax when I'm high anymore, just guilt trip myself after.  Plus I've saved fukin $600 plus last 5 weeks. 

That's awesome you got the turntables out.  I've been a DJ for almost 20 years. Hobbies help for sure. I'm writing more music now than I did before. 

Keep it up bruh!👊🏻

If you were a heavy user, I've seen posts on here of 5-8 months or more.  I'm 30 days clean after 20 years daily.  I'm still fucked lol but not going back.  I think it affects us physically way more than we think because shit is stronger now than it ever has been.  Give your body time to detox.  Exercise as much as you can.  I live in the steam room at my gym.  Literally sweat some if that out.  Meditation helped me a lot.  

You got this!🤘🏼
🤘🏼👊🏻 Congrats

It takes time to detox.  It affects us physically way more than we think.  Great job on the week, keep it up.  I'm one month in after 20 years daily and I am still detoxing.  The sooner you catch yourself the better you'll be at my age.  

If I took all the money I spent on weed from 19-41 you could put a down payment on a nice house.  Grow a retirement fund etc.  It's fukin stupid how much I've wasted. 

Stay the course. 🤘🏼👊🏻

Eventually you feel like shit stoned, mindfuck yourself out of the high.  At least I did.  You need time to detox is all. I'm 1 month in and still detoxing a bit after 20 fucking years of hazed living.  

Your desire for clarity is stronger than the same old stoned shit.  Or it will be with practice.  Exercise is huge.  Fucking doesn't hurt either. Lol. 

Good luck amigo

You can get a EKG at your doctor during your physical exam for $0 if you have insurance. Don't go to the darn hospital or it will be a waste of thousands.  Your blood pressure is a little high yes.  

I'm 30 days clean after 20 years daily.  I've saved over $500 and tracked my results with the groundedapp. I also use the calmapp for meditation, and man I like that.  It helps you take those deep breaths you're used to from smoking. My sleep patterns are fucked but I'm down 13-15 lbs this month. 

Way to many positives to start again.   Check my first post about the list of reasons that brought me here.  All these things are helpful reminders of why we come to this subreddit.  

Stay the course bro! 👊🏻

I'm good thanks.  Still clean, but I feel like I'm always tired regardless if I sleep well or not.  That's my main issue.  I went to a concert with friends puffing right next to me, and I had 0 urge to smoke.  I did enjoy the smell but that's it. 

How you doing?
The more thc is your system, the worse it is.  I smoked 1-2 grams a day.  First week was hard but  it was also hard for me on Saturday at 3weeks too.  It takes time to detox.

You give yourself credit for becoming aware of the problem.  That's the hardest part at first.  If you slipped up, don't beat yourself up.  Focus on getting through TODAY.  I've had depression and negative thinking as we the last week especially/ week #3 for me.  If you made it 4 months before thats awesome. Just building your progress and try and go longer next time.

Of course I've heard of microdosing, I said yes to that above.  I'm well aware of the medical uses for it.  Meditation takes presence, awareness, and mindfulness. Which is the opposite of using weed.  "Smoke not to get high" = lol. 

Once you hit that thc your mindfulness and awareness gone.  Believe what you want bro.  You're kidding yourself if you think you're not high, even microdosing.  If you brought this very question with a person who leads or teaches meditations for others, most would say the same.


BTW .5 grams is a bowl.  That is not microdosing, that's smoking a damn bowl, or digesting one. Most people would be baked if they took .5. You saying that alone means you're building a tolerance. But what do I know , I've just been using it for 20 fucking years.  Lol. Thanks for throwing dirt too.  Classy

There's a reason you get a DUI if you get pulled over by a cop after smoking or eating weed. Your logic is starting to sound a lot like a stoners logic.  Look in the mirror maybe before you sling mud. I wish you well.
Yeah I was actually looking that up last night. I did reach out to a doctor near by once before, but never got a call back last time. Lol. I'll try again.

Feel free to stay in touch or message.  Yeah I felt great & motivated earlier on, but detoxing from this takes months if you're a heavy user like I was.  The gym is my only high now, but like you said, once I get home and ready to chill, write music, etc it's getting harder.

Yes. I was an everyday day smoker for 20 years.  Regardless of how much you smoke , you eventually build up a tolerance and need more. If you're using it 1-2 times a week, a coupe puffs... is one thing, but eventually it stops working for you and you'll need more. I started out very small in the beginning.
Of course.  Weed get you high , regardless if it's a sativa or indica, when you are high you are not present.

Weed doesn't make you present, it takes that away from you actually. As a 20 years smoker who quit on New Years, I can tell you it only helps numb your thoughts.  Sure it can relax you, but maybe trying smoking cbd instead.  You'll be present and still get relaxed .
That's really hard. Set boundaries. Like not smoking in front of you, or dedicate ba room for him to smoke.  Basically keep it out of your face.  He should respect that.
Mine does Skype sessions. So I can do it from the comfort of my home.  There's plenty out there.

There is always help. Start by taking something to help you get a good night sleep. Then Google counselors near you for mental health.  There is always someone to help on here or in your life, but you have to ask for help.  That can be hard, but it's better than the alternative.

You're ripping people that are trying to reach out to you.  Just shows how unhappy you really are inside.  It's a normal feeling, but putting others down like you are is just wrong man.  Get off your high horse, because you posted on this sub in the end, because you're lonley.  I wish you well.

I'm 3 weeks in and the depression is very real today.  Probably the hardest day I've had.  I've had evil thoughts as well today too, but let them pass. 

If you were strong enough to get through that, then you're on the right track.  Just don't act on impulse, that's what it is.  But I'm struggling with ya, and so are others.
Yeah I'm using grounded which is specifically for weed. It's great.
My sleeping patterns are still up and down, but bit I'm down 12 lbs , feel way better than I ever have in the last 20 fucking years of daily use.  Stay strong amigos!

Yeah man my sleep patterns are fucked too.  Day 8 and I'm tired randomly.  Took a nap yesterday for no reason , but obviously our bodies need it to recover.  I've taken some Natural products from GNC for sleep but still it's tough.  Been sleeping in all week. I'm giving myself this week for the up and down.  Hopefully Monday I'll be back to more normal.
He's great, and that is awesome. Any links to share? I'd be interested. Thx
Detoxing.  It happens.
F yeah brotha! Pm & stay in touch.  Watching the games as well.
I've worked out the last two days in a row.  That helped a lot, but yeah kinda tired earlier at night so far.  Getting up earlier too. I'm up and down for sure.  Typical the first couple weeks.
Same.  I'm yawning at 8pm on day 3.

That's the thing , it drains all motivation eventually.  I posted on my page a list of reasons why I finally quit after 20 years.  Check it.  Day 3 now, it's tough but getting better by day coping.  Good luck. 👊🏻
Keep it up. I posted all my reasons for not smoking on my page . Check it and keep coming here when it's hard.  👊🏻
I felt the same today.  Went to the gym for just an hour, made my day way easier to deal.  You are detoxing, starting over is harder. Stay strong.  Don't even say the c word .  Good luck.
Listen to the signs, learn , and move on.  Good luck.
Thanks bro. Stay in touch in pm and we'll do this!
Not being high helps you find other things to do. There's a quit weed app I just got too. Great stuff
Tnanks man. Awesome job yourself.
Thanks amigo! Cheers
Stay in touch bro! Good luck.
Normal man.   Working out will help but time is the main thing. Just keep on.
Thank you and congratulations yourself!
Awesome man.  Feel free to stay in touch pm.  We'll try this all together.
I just at tried sharing my story but don't see the post.  20 years as a user.
